race.comment: STAY HUMBLE (1) went forward last start over 1547m at Geelong and held on well for second, beaten a neck. Won't find this as tough so he is likely to play a big role. WASHINGTON LILAC (11) is a horse who has always been highly-regarded, hence being tested in the Adrian Knox Stks last prep. As that suggests, she'll be better over further than this, but it looks a suitable kick-off. CORONATIONHERCULES (4) is the most lightly-raced runner in the race but hasn't done a lot wrong to date and an continue his good progression here. DIAMANDA (7) was prominent at the corner and finished second last start at the first run back from a spell over 1600m at Moe, beaten 2 lengths. Will benefit from that outing. Placed to advantage and can feature in the finish.
